title: Support and system information commands
summary: Expand Help with privacy-safe system diagnostics, direct issue and feature reporting, development support, and a single menu-only keyboard shortcut entry.

questions.question: Which machine fields are useful without creating a privacy leak?
questions.decision: Copy only version, build identifier, release channel/type, OS family/version, architecture, locale, and generic rendering engine; exclude identity, network, paths, projects, accounts, and credentials.

questions.question: Should reporting open generic Issues or maintained forms?
questions.decision: Use the exact bug.yml and feature.yml GitHub issue-template URLs.

questions.question: Which configured funding destination is primary?
Which layouts receive the commands and how should keyboard help behave?
questions.answer: Add new commands everywhere and retain the recommended keyboard boundary.
questions.decision: All four new commands appear on desktop/touch; Keyboard shortcuts stays desktop-only under Help.

questions.question: What feedback and recovery are required for copy failure?
questions.answer: Use transient success and non-blocking retryable failure feedback.
questions.decision: Close the menu, announce success after copy, and show Retry plus dismiss when copy or diagnostics fail.

dependencies.reason: The completed shared desktop/touch ApplicationMenu architecture is the required Help command surface.

risks: Machine diagnostics could expose personal or fingerprinting data beyond the approved payload.
Clipboard APIs differ across secure browser, Tauri desktop, and Android environments and can fail after permission denial.
External links can navigate the app, retain opener access, or silently fail if not opened through a platform-safe boundary.
Build SHA and release channel can drift from packaged version metadata if CI injection has no deterministic fallback.
Duplicated desktop/touch actions or feedback state could diverge from the shared menu architecture.
Removing the app-bar shortcut could accidentally remove the Help or question-mark access path.
validation: Unit-test diagnostic formatting, missing-value fallbacks, generic engine detection, deterministic build metadata, and prohibited-field absence.
Playwright-test desktop/touch Help ordering, copy success/failure/retry feedback, exact external URLs, Home/Editor neutrality, and keyboard shortcut access after app-bar removal.
Test native diagnostics on Windows and compile/check guarded macOS, Linux, and Android paths without shell permissions.
Run desktop, phone, and tablet accessibility and visual QA for menu containment, notices, focus, touch targets, and reduced motion.
Run studio lint, typecheck, unit tests, static build, Playwright, Rust format/clippy/check, spec validation, Prettier, and git diff checks.
